label: Monday–Tuesday night: the overcoat is laid across the furze-bush
quote: it was laid across the bush
note: There was no wind that night, so the coat was placed there, not blown (¶96). The text does not say by whom or whether it was before or after the struggle.

label: A wax vesta, half burned, comes to lie in the mud of the hollow
quote: It was a wax vesta half burned
note: The story does not say when or by whom. Holmes expected to find it. It lay buried in the mud before Thursday's search.

label: Silver Blaze casts the horseshoe the Inspector now holds
quote: a cast horseshoe of Silver Blaze

label: Silver Blaze is entered for the Wessex Cup
quote: remove our horse's name from the entries for the Cup

label: Many feet trample the hollow since Monday night; the matting is laid at the side
quote: many feet have been here since Monday night
note: The matting (¶99) is laid at some time after the body was found and before Thursday.

label: The Inspector bags Straker's boot, Simpson's shoe and the cast horseshoe
quote: In this bag I have one of the boots which Straker wore

label: Gregory examines the ground for a hundred yards in each direction
quote: I have examined the ground very carefully for a hundred yards in each direction

label: Thursday evening: after a short walk across the moor, the party at the brink of the hollow by the furze-bush
quote: A short walk across the moor took us to the hollow in which the body had been found

label: Thursday evening: Holmes descends into the hollow, studies the mud and finds the vesta
quote: descending into the hollow, he pushed the matting into a more central position

label: Thursday evening: Holmes compares the boots with the marks, then climbs to the rim and searches the ferns
quote: Then he clambered up to the rim of the hollow

label: Thursday evening, before dark: Holmes's walk over the moor (planned)
quote: I should like to take a little walk over the moor before it grows dark
note: Holmes's stated intention; the scene ends before the walk is told.

label: Thursday evening: Colonel Ross and the Inspector go back to Straker's house (intended)
quote: You will find us at poor Straker's house when you have finished your walk

label: Thursday evening: the drive together into Tavistock (planned)
quote: we can drive together into Tavistock

label: Friday: Holmes's work on the ground (planned)
quote: that I may know my ground to-morrow
